# Your System, Now

> A live, read-only view of how Joel's whole system stands at once:
> every machine on his mycelium, the mycelium itself, his home network
> and his code, each judged from its own owner's answer, with the way
> deeper into each.

- [The page](index.html): the weather over everything he runs. A
  headline counting what is worth a look, the outlook of the four parts
  each wearing its sky (clear, cloud, storm or fog), and the four parts
  in one column, walked by keyboard or pointer.
- [The page as text](index.md): how each part is judged, the keys, and
  what the data holds.
- The data: the system daemon's records, which the page watches live
  over the sites' server at /feed/system. An agent on the machine runs
  `system --json` itself.
- [All his sites](../llms.txt): the home this page sits in.
